recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, warm-toned portrait of a female vocalist with a 1960s bouffant hairstyle, set against a blurred, vertically striped background of red and teal. The composition features a mix of bold sans-serif and expressive swash-heavy display typography in vibrant pink and white, with a characteristic 'hype sticker' graphic in the corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's face as the central emotional anchor
Vibrant pink display type arching over the subject's head
Vertical color bands in the background contrasting with the horizontal lean of the subject
Small, dense blocks of white metadata text balancing the large display titles
coreInvariants: Warm, saturated skin tones with deep shadows
Visible film grain and soft focus in the background
High-sheen texture on the subject's clothing (sequins)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Close-up portrait occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame, leaning slightly to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright pink arched title.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left artist name, follows the arched title across the subject's hair, down to the tracklist on the left, and finally to the blue sticker in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Tight composition with minimal negative space, filled by background color bands and text blocks.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm amber and brown (skin tones and shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Hot pink (main title) and Cyan (hype sticker)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the accents against a mid-value, high-contrast photographic base.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to mid-century process colors: cyan, magenta, yellow, black

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Grotesque sans-serif and decorative swash serif
letterConstructionRules: Artist name in a heavy, tight-kerning sans-serif
Title in a high-contrast serif with extreme, decorative swashes on 'O', 'H', and 't'
characterSpecificRedesigns: Curled, whip-like swashes extending from the ascenders and descenders of the title script
Tight, almost overlapping letter spacing in the artist name
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy sans-serif for authority paired with flamboyant swash-serif for emotional expression.
graphicDevices: Angled rectangular 'hype sticker' in the top right corner
Small bullet points separating list items

preserve: Hot pink color for main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 60s/70s decorative serif feel with exaggerated terminals
Matches the heavy, tight-packed feel of the artist name

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1960s style portrait of a woman with a large bouffant hairstyle wearing a gold sequined dress. The background should be out of focus with vertical stripes of muted red and teal. Use warm, high-contrast film lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large arched title in hot pink decorative swash lettering across the top third. Place a heavy white sans-serif name in the top left. Add a cyan rectangular sticker at a 15-degree angle in the top right with white condensed text.

verificationChecks: Title text arches correctly over the subject's head
Background stripes are vertically oriented and blurred
Color palette includes hot pink, cyan, teal, and red

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the background color stripes
Degree of swash decoration on the title font
Angle and color of the hype sticker
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or record label logos
Specific song titles listed in the tracklist
The specific face of the individual in the photo

mustAchieve: Authentic 1960s film grain and color saturation
Balanced typographic hierarchy despite multiple text blocks
avoid: Default system fonts like Arial or Times New Roman

postGenerationChecks: Does the image look like a physical vinyl record cover?
Is the pink title the most prominent graphic element?
Is the lighting on the subject's face dramatic and warm?
Are the sequins on the dress rendered with realistic specular highlights?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast 60s soul portrait with arched decorative swash typography and a corner hype sticker for a period-accurate album aesthetic.
